title: Samsung names Choi Won-Joon head of its mobile division, replacing TM Roh, who stays as Samsung co-CEO, and Sang Joon Hwang to lead its memory business (Ben Schoon/9to5Google)
summary: Ben Schoon / 9to5Google: Samsung names Choi Won-Joon head of its mobile division, replacing TM Roh, who stays as Samsung co-CEO, and Sang Joon Hwang to lead its memory business — After the better part of 7 years, Samsung's mobile division has a new chief and it's Choi Won-Joon, who is already off to a great start …
